recent.summary: AutoMapper: Uncontrolled Recursion with Constructor Parameters
recent.description:
### Summary
`MaxDepth`, whether set explicitly or applied by default (64) to self-referential type maps, was not enforced when the recursion goes through constructor parameters. Mapping a deeply nested source to a destination built through its constructor, such as a positional `record`, recurses without bound and throws a `StackOverflowException`. That exception can't be caught and terminates the process. This bypasses the mitigation for CVE-2026-32933.

The type depth used by `MaxDepth` was incremented only after the destination object was created. Constructor parameters, including child objects of the same type, are mapped while the destination is created, so each level recursed before its parent was counted, and the depth check never tripped.

recent.description:

The default and explicit `MaxDepth` limits added for CVE-2026-32933 don't apply to several mapping paths. Mapping a deeply nested source through any of them recurses without bound and throws a `StackOverflowException`, which can't be caught and terminates the process.

recent.description:

This advisory has been withdrawn because it is a duplicate of GHSA-273h-m46v-96q4. This link is maintained to preserve external references.

### Original Description
ImageMagick before 7.1.2-15 and 6.9.x before 6.9.13-40 contains an integer overflow in the PSB (PSD v2) RLE decoding path (ReadPSDChannelRLE in coders/psd.c) that causes a heap out-of-bounds read on 32-bit builds. Processing a crafted PSB file can lead to information disclosure or a crash.

recent.summary: ImageMagick: Memory leak in coders/txt.c without freetype
recent.description: If a `texture` attribute is specified for a TXT file, an attempt will be made to read it via `texture=ReadImage(read_info,exception);`. Later, when retrieving metrics via the `GetTypeMetrics` function, if this function fails (i.e., `status == MagickFalse`), the calling function will exit immediately but fail to release the texture object, leading to memory leakage.

recent.summary: ImageMagick: SVG-to-MVG Command Injection via coders/svg.c
recent.description: An attacker can inject arbitrary MVG (Magick Vector Graphics) drawing commands in an SVG file that is read by the internal SVG decoder of ImageMagick. The injected MVG commands execute during rendering.

recent.summary: ImageMagick: Malicious PCD files trigger 1‑byte heap Out-of-bounds Read and DoS
recent.description: The PCD coder’s DecodeImage loop allows a crafted PCD file to trigger a 1‑byte heap out-of-bounds read when decoding an image (Denial of service) and potential disclosure of adjacent heap byte.

recent.summary: ImageMagick has a possible heap Use After Free vulnerability in its meta coder
recent.description:
A heap Use After Free vulnerability exists in the meta coder when an allocation fails and a single byte is written to a stale pointer.

```
==535852==ERROR: AddressSanitizer: heap-use-after-free on address 0x5210000088ff at pc 0x5581bacac14d bp 0x7ffdf667edf0 sp 0x7ffdf667ede0
WRITE of size 1 at 0x5210000088ff thread T0
```

recent.summary: ImageMagick: Integer Overflow in PSB (PSD v2) RLE decoding path causes heap Out of Bounds reads for 32-bit builds
recent.description:
An integer overflow in the PSB (PSD v2) RLE decoding path causes a heap out-of-bounds read on 32-bit builds. This can lead to information disclosure or a crash when processing crafted PSB files.

```
=================================================================
==3298==ERROR: AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow on address 0xf512eb00 at pc 0xf76760b5 bp 0xffc1dfb8 sp 0xffc1dfa8
READ of size 8 at 0xf512eb00 thread T0
    #0 0xf76760b4 in ReadPSDChannelRLE coders/psd.c:1141
```

recent.summary: Couchbase .NET SDK (client library) does not properly enable hostname verification for TLS certificates
recent.description: The Couchbase .NET SDK (client library) before 3.7.1 does not properly enable hostname verification for TLS certificates. In fact, the SDK was also using IP addresses instead of hostnames due to a configuration option that was incorrectly enabled by default.

cwes.name: Improper Validation of Certificate with Host Mismatch
